description:
After 25 years, a classic is reborn! DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends return for the modern era. Using Unreal Engine 5, the officers and battlefields of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 have been recreated in stunning detail.

Take 1 vs. 1,000 action to new heights with even more exhilarating combat! While faithfully recreating the feel and movement of the original game, the action system of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 has evolved to deliver an even more thrilling experience.
